notes: Tightened the Wins page so every win is backed by the numbers. A win is now only marked earned when something real caused it, such as a recorded payment; edits, removed debts and synced changes no longer switch one on quietly. Months on plan are judged against the target each month actually had, so lowering your extra later does not rewrite earlier months. Plan forecast wins, like interest avoided and months sooner, show as earned only while your current plan supports them. Deleting a payment logged by mistake also takes back any win it triggered. First card under $1,000 now counts only for a card that started above that.
